name: Moto Rush Reborn
detailed_description:
Welcome to Neo-Tokyo, a sprawling megalopolis. In Moto Rush Reborn you’ll drive through its streets in a fast-paced, action-filled adventure, mixing elements from racing games and runners. Will you outrun your demons or be lost to the darkness?

Become a real daredevil

Risk your life as you drive through traffic! Dodge and weave through obstacles at breakneck speeds, requiring you to steer with deadly precision and razor-sharp reflexes. 

45 challenging levels

Drive through tunnels, highways and the city centre in this breathtaking megalopolis. Face 45 challenging levels in a variety of locations: power plants, abandoned service tunnels, shopping districts, festivals and many more!

Unravel the mystery of a demonic machine

Experience a story of friendship and demonic possession in our hand-drawn manga. Collect demonic symbols hidden throughout each level and unlock them by mastering the game to unlock its panels. Uncover the true nature of your vehicle and the demon that inhabits its engine.

short_description: Feel the rush of adrenaline as you weave and dodge through obstacles in a retro-futuristic Tokyo! Slide, jump and drive as you try to outrun the demon possessing your body in this fast-paced, thrilling adventure. Will you manage to escape, or be forever lost?
